description: Participants can identify an appropriate published engineering capability and prepare its project-portable invocation with sufficient context, applicable authority, and complete triggered resources.

includes: Capability discovery using purpose, triggers, exclusions, and behavioral owner.
Portable or governed invocation preparation in the participant's project.
Conditionally required evidence and resource access, explicit prerequisites, and safe stops.
excludes: Performing an entire project lifecycle merely because a capability was selected.
Claiming package integrity from one successful invocation.
